meta.name: LLM Affinity Matrix
meta.purpose: Declarative role→substrate routing before MLP override. Cheap-first for bulk roles, heavy-only for deep roles.
meta.authority: Advisory — governance.mjs hard gates always win. MLP router may override when warm + confident.
meta.decisionRule: Migrate workload class only when substrate-benchmark shows ≥2× pass rate or ≥50% latency reduction

glm-max.description: z.ai glm-5.2 1M ctx — heavy reasoning, architecture, adversarial

tmux-zai.description: z.ai glm-5.2 via interactive tmux claude-zai — multi-tool builds

helmsman.rationale: Owner cockpit — needs native tools + commit authority

architect.rationale: Deep system design — needs 1M ctx + reasoning high

steward.rationale: Deterministic governance — no LLM substrate needed

ideator.rationale: Divergent generation — mid-cost sufficient, not heavy reasoning

scout.rationale: Bulk research + census — cheap-first, high throughput

synthesist.rationale: Large-context merge — needs 1M ctx for lattice synthesis

evolver.rationale: Evolutionary search + deep proposals — heavy reasoning

sentinel.rationale: Security review — needs native tools for protected-path audit

adjudicator.rationale: Adversarial critic — needs deep reasoning, structurally independent

oracle.rationale: Test execution + fitness scoring — native tools for test runs

calibrator.rationale: Calibration math — deterministic, no LLM substrate needed

archivist.rationale: Memory curation + skill library — bulk scan, cheap-first

quartermaster.rationale: Token budget accounting — deterministic, no LLM substrate needed

envoy.rationale: Task intake + requirement decode — bulk processing, cheap-first
